_doc: How each figure walks and stands (scripts/render/soldier_anim.gd). Edit freely; values apply on the next battle. A type takes 'default', then its entry in 'types' ('like' copies another type first). Lengths are world px at zoom 1, angles radians, times seconds. stride: one cycle of two steps. pace: march time per tile (x the base). bounce: rise at the passing step (two per stride). waddle: tilt toward the planted foot. squash/stretch: height lost at a landing / gained at the push-off. surge: forward-and-back swing along the march, slowest at each landing. lean: forward lean on the march; kick: extra lean while the body lags the start or skids at the stop. jitter: uneven, scrambling steps (0..1). tempo: spread of the men's own tempo. stomp: heavy landings (more dust; 1 and above shake the camera). spring/damp: how the body follows the squad's anchor (higher spring follows closer; damping under 1 overshoots at the stop). breath: share of the height the upper body sinks on an out-breath; breath_rate: breaths per second. sway: px of slow weight shifting; bend: lean of the upper body over the hips with it. fidget: mean seconds between idle fidgets (0: none). dust: size of the footstep puffs. march: x the time a squad takes per tile (all kinds). rig: 1 walks a figure's own legs when it walks away from the camera (the standing back view as a mesh; tools/anim/rig.py), 0 keeps its drawn walk frames. duty: share of a stride a foot is planted. step: farthest a foot reaches ahead of or behind the hips, as a share of the figure's height (the march's speed sets it below that, so the planted foot keeps still). lift: how high the swung foot rises (share of height). hip, knee: where the lower body starts to follow the feet and below which it goes with them whole (share of height from the feet).
